arrival_disposition.applicable_clause: AB1 prereg amendment 7 lines 671-673, amended to 15 fits by amendment 7b lines 692-697: read once when fits end, latest 15 Nov 18:00; later rows labelled late.
arrival_disposition.earlier_clause: Section 7 lines 203-207 is the original ab1_read.py --branch R read of the original 40 networks, ending by 14 Nov 12:00 CET. It does not impose an earlier archive collection deadline on the subsequent amendment-7 Batch-C reuse.
arrival_disposition.provenance_clause: Section 7 lines 208-212: native provenance guards and two verified copies with job-sidecar check. Current remote/local hash agreement plus local job-sidecar agreement meets the two-copy byte condition; embedded identity is guarded on read.
arrival_disposition.historical_collection_exact_times: unknown for original comparators; retained as aggregate historical evidence only, not reconstructed
arrival_disposition.no_new_requirement: No clause requires an earlier per-file copy timestamp for this registered reuse; preparation gap is resolved by current-before-cutoff source/integrity and individual completion evidence.

execution_conditions: Execute only the bound command and inputs; verify identity/absence still hold at start. If evidence or files change, stop for review rather than substitute.
Create stdout/stderr/execution receipt exclusively; capture start/end UTC, elapsed, exit, final admission JSON SHA256, source/input/archive/environment hashes and output SHA256.
Reader alone atomically claims; retain permanent claim and every failure/partial output. No deletion or automatic reread.
Native identity, ordered finite scores, embedded manifests and fit provenance remain on-read guards. Preserve each native refusal and independent disposition before conclusions.
Include the already validated descriptive learner report and context labels with eventual results; no new companion calculation needed.
Independent results review before scientific conclusions.
native_boundary: Opaque hashes, scheduler completion and filenames do not establish embedded TASK/ARM/SEED, ordered finite scores, train/eval manifests, GPU/steps/pack/overlay/n_items/loss. These remain guards on the first separately authorized read; never call native validator as metadata preflight. Permanent claim and failures retained; no automatic retry.

registered_failure_policy.lost: Lost arm-seeds reported lost; no silent replacement
registered_failure_policy.infrastructure: Historical registration allows one unchanged H100 infrastructure retry; no retry is authorized here
registered_failure_policy.readability: Fewer than four readable paired seeds: not read. Native guard refusals must be retained and independently dispositioned, not silently called scientific failures.
